name: blocked redesign distinguishes retained implementation
requiredPattern: (?is)approved redesign.*becomes `\[ \]` with no retained implementation or `\[~\]` with retained implementation

name: pre-approval cancellation does not persist scope
requiredPattern: (?is)Rejection/cancellation before approval leaves `AC\.md` unchanged

name: post-persistence pre-code cancellation preserves approved states
requiredPattern: (?is)Cancellation after persistence but before code keeps.*new targets remain `\[ \]`.*edited/resumed targets retain

name: implementation cancellation drains delegates before reconciliation
requiredPattern: (?is)On cancellation.*wait for/drain.*Mode A clears `active_tasks`.*status: paused.*never auto-resumes

name: active plan re-entry matches repository and approach identity
requiredPattern: (?is)plan matches only when.*status: active.*worktree.*branch.*baseline_commit.*target_acs.*approach_ref.*Reuse

name: explicit restart reuses one matching paused plan
requiredPattern: (?is)explicit restart.*paused plans.*same identity.*AC.*approach.*baseline.*exactly one matches.*clear `pause_reason`.*set it `active`.*never create a replacement

name: ambiguous active plans stop instead of choosing by time
requiredTerms: do not select by modification time
requiredPattern: (?is)multiple plans match.*stop before code.*reconcile.*do not select by modification time

name: manual pass persists current evidence before verified status
requiredPattern: (?is)AC-N passed.*replace the current-evidence row.*only then mark `\[x\]`

name: Mode B restores attempt state from AC evidence

requiredPattern: (?is)Mode B has no persistent plan.*latest Git commit.*target AC.*current evidence.*Recovery State.*approach_ref.*never reset attempts because chat context was lost

name: Mode B cancellation persists across sessions until explicit restart
requiredPattern: (?is)For Mode B.*replace.*current evidence.*Type `EXECUTION`.*Conclusion `RECOVERY STATE`.*state: cancelled.*no plan or `active_tasks`.*Explicit restart.*state: resumed.*without resetting attempts

name: expected TEST-FIRST red is excluded from failures
requiredPattern: (?is)Expected `TEST-FIRST` red.*do not count

name: blocked target does not prevent independent Phase 4.8 settlement
requiredPattern: (?is)implementation subset being settled.*`\[!\] \[blocked\]`.*independent target.*enter Phase 5

name: alternate verified path settles the obsolete blocked task
requiredPattern: (?is)another task freshly verifies every AC that required the blocked task.*mark the old task `superseded` with evidence.*otherwise it remains blocked

name: guided retry restores AC and Mode A task states conditionally
requiredPattern: (?is)User guidance.*blocked AC as `\[ \]` with no retained implementation or `\[~\]` when implementation remains.*Mode A.*task to `pending`.*attempt 4/4

name: Mode A redesign preserves one owner across mode selection
requiredTerms: moves Mode A to Mode B
requiredPattern: (?is)approved material redesign.*selection remains Mode A.*keep the sole active plan.*update `approach_ref`.*blocked tasks to `pending` attempt 0.*moves Mode A to Mode B.*pause_reason: superseded-by-mode-b.*never run both modes concurrently

name: Mode B guided attempt remains bounded after Mode A transition
requiredPattern: (?is)newly discovered risk or impact requires Mode B recovery to enter Mode A under the same approved approach.*import the attempt state.*instead of granting three new tries

name: external environment block settles Mode A task without consuming an attempt
requiredPattern: (?is)unavailable required environment/tool.*external block, not a failed cycle.*Mode A removes.*active_tasks.*marks it `blocked` without incrementing.*Continue independent work

name: cleared external block restores ready state without resetting history
requiredPattern: (?is)condition clears under the same approach.*Mode A returns its task to `pending` with attempt/evidence unchanged.*Mode B writes same-series `state: resumed`.*Phase 3\.5A imports its prior attempt/guided state.*rather than resetting

name: Mode A to Mode B redesign settles old ownership and deterministically hands back

requiredPattern: (?is)moves Mode A to Mode B.*stop new writes.*wait for/drain.*first persisted plan change sets `status: paused` and `pause_reason: superseded-by-mode-b.*before that marker, do not change `approach_ref`, task states, or `active_tasks`.*After the marker.*Ownership handback.*plan `completed`.*otherwise `active`

name: interrupted Mode A to Mode B transition retains a recoverable owner
requiredPattern: (?is)Reconcile a `superseded-by-mode-b` owner.*First complete its plan-side handoff idempotently.*in_progress.*pending.*Mode-B-owned tasks `superseded` with current evidence.*clear `active_tasks`.*set `approach_ref` from the pause marker.*write a missing reset.*recover an unfinished Mode B series.*ownership handback.*Do not use latest-completed fallback or create a replacement first

name: post-approval user rejection persists without consuming a failure attempt

requiredPattern: (?is)Rejection after approval.*does not count as a failed cycle.*pause_reason: user-rejected.*state: rejected.*explicit restart.*state: resumed.*without resetting attempts
